title: Bag of bricks-Orange 24
descriptionHtml:
Orange — colour 24

Warm and vivid without tipping into neon. Orange carries sunsets, autumn leaves and pumpkin season, and gives a design real heat when paired against blues.

Works well with: Bright Orange 35, Yellow 11, Deep Blue 13

  • Precision-moulded, compatible with all Memobrick kits and standard building bricks
  • Ideal for replacing missing pieces or extending an existing design
  • Supplied in a resealable bag for easy sorting and storage

seo.description: Orange bricks (colour 24) for Memobrick mosaics. A warm vivid orange for sunsets, autumn leaves and high-energy colour blocks.
